description: Trained recurrent SNN operator metrics. N=512 LIF networks trained on sequential MNIST and clusters tasks. Data aggregated from causal_reset experiments (prl_cv_criticality/) and point2_fair experiments (nature_matters_arising/).
key_finding: Weight reciprocity eta_W stays near 0 (non-symmetric) across ALL tasks, initializations, and regularizers. The operator is non-normal. The DMD-based eta_implied appears near 1 only because the diagonal leak term dominates; off-diagonal antisymmetry is large (~0.75).

weight_reciprocity.description: eta_W = <W_ij W_ji> / <W_ij^2> for the recurrent weight matrix. 1 = symmetric, 0 = independent, -1 = antisymmetric.

trajectory_clusters.description: eta_W evolution from epoch 0 to convergence

trajectory_mnist.description: eta_W goes NEGATIVE on MNIST (anti-symmetric drift)
trajectory_mnist.note: eta_W < 0 means anti-correlated reciprocity — opposite of symmetry

operator_asymmetry.description: ||Jbar - Jbar^T|| / ||Jbar|| — Frobenius asymmetry fraction of the time-averaged gated Jacobian

prl_reported_asymmetry.description: As reported in PRL supplemental Table SX

dmd_metrics.description: Dynamic Mode Decomposition metrics from recurrent SNN spike trains

clusters_N512_baseline.warning: dmd_eta ~ 0.98 appears near-symmetric but is a DIAGONAL-DOMINATED artifact. The off-diagonal antisymmetry is ~0.75 (see dmd_offdiag_antisym).

mnist_N512_baseline.note: MNIST has LARGER antisymmetry (~0.19) and LOWER dmd_eta (~0.93) — more non-normal than clusters

dmd_imag_spread_sdt.description: DMD imaginary-part standard deviation from SDT spectral analysis

spectral_radii.description: Spectral radii at different levels of the operator
spectral_radii.note: weight_rho >> 1 (supercritical weights), but dmd_rho < 1 (subcritical effective dynamics) — the spike reset provides dynamic stabilization. This is the non-normal stabilization mechanism.

covariance_exponents.description: Power-law exponent nu of the covariance eigenspectrum
covariance_exponents.note: nu_mem and nu_spike are DIFFERENT — the exponent is probe-dependent. nu_spike is lower because spikes are thresholded. The spontaneous (noise-driven) exponent differs from the task-driven one. This probe-dependence is a key argument in energy_nonnormal.
